rule_basis: Scored predictions use challenge-provided study-region estimator outputs only. No hidden labels, removed reference layers, external lab values, leaderboard scores, or LB-derived constants are inputs. Eastern-WA is a platform-only deterministic zero fill.

selection.eligible_idea_rule: implemented idea with channel='gap', component in R/B/F/Est, and a complete official-ID parquet; recomputed on every build so later families plug in without editing this config
selection.undefined_rows: exclude from that component mean; do not turn undefined into a zero-valued observation
selection.multi_component_poi: average available F and Est component estimates with equal weight
selection.poi_composite: average whichever of F and Est is defined; if neither is defined, POI is undefined
selection.composite: equal mean of defined R, B, and POI components for A2/A3
selection.a1_composite: recompute Sca5 over the registry-driven gap estimates while excluding forbidden Tm1; apply a region-wise additive level offset so the expected-definedness composite region mean equals the Dst5 organizer-published-undefined-share calibrated incomplete-probability mean, then clip to [0,1]
selection.published_anchor_recomputation: recompute Dst4 and Dst5 from current provided-feature idea outputs with Tm1 excluded; recompute Sca5 with the same filtered registry; never consume the previously emitted Dst4/Dst5/Sca5 Parquets because those may transitively include Tm1
selection.a1_components: equal arithmetic mean of all eligible gap-scale ideas within each component, one vote per idea
selection.a2_family_reduction: arithmetic mean of eligible ideas within each family and component before factor weighting
selection.a2_factor: on each component's family means, center and standardize each family over official tracts; first eigenvector of the off-diagonal Pearson correlation matrix estimates one-factor loadings; orient to positive correlation with the equal-family anchor; weights are max(loading,0)/max(1-loading^2,0.05), normalized to sum one; if fewer than two families or degenerate covariance, use equal family weights
selection.a3_binary_witness: registered witness value >= 0.5 indicates evidence for a facility-miss event; undefined witness is missing, not negative
selection.a3_dawid_skene: deterministic binary Dawid-Skene EM, alpha=1 Laplace smoothing for prevalence/sensitivity/specificity, initialize latent prevalence to clipped observed positive share and each annotator sensitivity/specificity to 0.75; use posterior miss probability for F when at least two witness ideas are available, otherwise retain A2 F; other components use A2; compose by equal mean of defined R/B/POI

candidates.purpose: fixed physical gap mappings, equal weights within component, Sca5 composite, and Dst5 published-aggregate region level
label-free one-factor spectral/Bartlett-style family weights; family members averaged first
unsupervised Dawid-Skene facility-miss posterior plus A2 component estimates

forbidden: removed reference layers or equivalent copies

forecast.reason: No local target labels or permitted holdout exists; candidate forecasts must not be fabricated. No upload is authorized by this preregistration.
